title: Just A Chat Mod
description: You can now keybind every Message / command with a single click! (Made by DaNexoo)
body:
# Just A Chat Mod

Minecraft Mod that Adds an Advanced Keybinding Menu
This mod introduces a powerful in-game menu that lets you bind every chat message and command to a custom key. Unlike vanilla keybinding, this system allows you to combine multiple keybinds together for complex actions. Customize your gameplay workflow with ease and create shortcuts for everything, from quick commands to intricate macros—all from a simple, user-friendly interface.

This mod was made by DaNexoo!
